svg.title: No game selected — pointing skeleton with controller
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction at the original 1254 by 1254 coordinates. White bones use uniform 16 px #0a0505 outlines, matching no-games-found.svg. The skull, arm bones, palms, individual finger sections and controller are complete closed shapes, with hidden portions reconstructed beneath overlaps. Each eye has its own feature group. Layer names use viewer-left and viewer-right. data-pivot values are suggested animation pivots in SVG coordinates; no animation is applied. Eyes also have hidden circular tracking irises, shared clipping paths, dark rims, and invisible center travel guides. The original illustrated view is the default.
